snippet.title: Tamzin Twins Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Tamzin Twins is the story of two evil twin girls who have spent their lives working for the malicious Tyrek Tefari. One day he casts them aside and nearly kills them both. They survive the attack and vow revenge on their former leader, no matter what army or fortress is in their way. On their path to revenge they will discover what it means to be leaders, to be chivalrous, and how to be queens.
